name: ATA
description: In air-to-air counter-UAV scenarios, vision–language tracking for tiny drones still lacks a dedicated benchmark. Unlike traditional UAV tracking or ground-based Anti-UAV settings, air-to-air counter-UAV tracking involves simultaneous motion of both the tracking platform and the target platform. In addition, the target typically appears as a tiny object and is subject to rapid viewpoint changes, fast background transitions, and interference from similar drones, making it difficult to systematically assess the capability boundaries of existing methods.
